learning_outcomes.text: A student can formulate the engineering problem for the given system subjected to the load, solve this problem and explain obtained results
A student can formulate an engineering problem for the given mechanical construction and solve this problem by applying energetic methods and failure criteria
A student can formulate a mathematical model that considers mechanical loading and thermal influence, apply engineering tools to solve this engineering problem

syllabus_topics: Statically determinate and statically indeterminate problems
Planar state of stress and 2D Mohrs circle
Energy theorems: Clapeyrons theorem, Bettis theorem, Maxwells theorem (Maxwell-Mohrs method), Castigliano theorem, Menabreas theorem (Menabrea-Castiglianos method)
Deflection of beam. Statically determinate and statically indeterminate problems. Clebschs method
State of stress. Planar state of stress and 2D Mohrs circle
Beams and frames: Maxwells theorem (Maxwell-Mohrs method) and Castigliano theorem
Pressure vessels. Thin walled structure. Thick walled structure
assessment_rules: To pass, a student needs a minimum of 56.0% in the laboratory's test, 56.0% in the tutorials' tests, and 56.0% in the lectures' test. The final grade is composed of 20.0% from the laboratory's test, 30.0% from the tutorials' tests, and 50.0% from the lectures' test.

degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
